## Shopify product groups

Shows separate products as one family on the storefront, like Shopify Plus combined listings, on any plan. A cable sold as one product per length and colour gets a Length row and a Colour row on every member's page, each option a link to the right product.

### How it works
1. **Setup** (run once) creates the `group_overrides` and `group_changes` tables, the **Product group** metaobject and two product fields: `product_group` and `option_values`.
2. **Group** (hourly) reads your active products and finds each series: same vendor, same product type and the same title once the option values (a length, a colour, a capacity) and the SKU are taken out. It writes one Product group per series, links each product to it, and keeps every member's stock in the group's `members_json`. Only the differences are written. It starts as a dry run.

### Setup
1. Credentials: Custom Auth with your Shopify client ID and secret on both **Get Shopify token** nodes, Slack API on **Post summary**.
2. Fill in **Setup settings** and **Group settings**, then run **Run once to set up**.
3. Add the two theme blocks from the guide (or the README's `liquid` folder), so the groups show.
4. Run **Run Group now** with `dry_run` on, read the Slack summary, then set `dry_run` to false.

### Customisation
Options are a list in **Group settings**: each has a `name` and a `pattern` (a regular expression) or a list of `words`. Put a product in a group by hand, or keep it out, with a row in `group_overrides`. Groups you make yourself in the admin (with **Kept by n8n** off) are never changed.

## Setup (run once)
Creates the two data tables, the Product group metaobject and the two product fields. Running it again changes nothing and reports them as already there.

## Group (hourly)
Finds every series in your catalogue, writes one Product group per series and links its products. Compares with what Shopify already holds, so a run with nothing new writes nothing. Posts to Slack only when something changed.

nodes.name: Group settings
nodes.notes: options: the order is the row order on the product page. dry_run: list the changes in Slack, write nothing. report_hour: the run in this hour also posts near misses and duplicates.

nodes.name: Get Shopify token for Group
nodes.notes: Client credentials grant: a fresh Admin API token for this run. See SETUP.md.

nodes.name: Read products
nodes.notes: Active products on the online store only: draft and archived products have no page to link to.

nodes.name: Find series
nodes.notes: Why Code: series are found by stripping option values and SKUs from titles, then compared with Shopify field by field.
